meta.name: lint-fixer
meta.description: Mandatory post-implementation lint and type-checking skill that runs after ANY code change, bug fix, new feature, refactor, API change, or configuration modification. Ensures all TypeScript type errors, Effect-TS ecosystem issues, and lint errors are resolved. Use after every implementation that modifies source files.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动修复代码风格与类型错误，让检查通过
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常被 lint 和类型错误卡住，希望代码自动变干净。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically fix code style and type errors so checks pass.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on lint and type errors and want automatic cleanup.

howto.what: 代码修改后自动运行强制检查:先用 tsc 查 TypeScript 类型错误,再用 Biome/ESLint 修 lint 问题,整理导入顺序,检测 Effect-TS 复杂模式,最后请 NEURO 做回归验证。修复完成前不会把控制权交还用户,确保不引入新错误。
howto.when: 在代码变更、修复 bug、新增功能后触发;重构、API 修改、配置变更时同样会运行。技能被标记为强制后置步骤,凡改动源文件都会进入此流程。

say.text: 跑一遍类型检查,把 TypeScript 报错都修掉
say.note: 执行 tsc --noEmit 并套用自动修复。

say.text: 检查我刚才的改动,修复所有 lint 报错
say.note: 运行 Biome/ESLint 并自动修复可修复项。

say.text: 我的代码里有 Effect-TS 类型错误,帮我修
say.note: 按错误族匹配内置修复模式。

howto.what_en: After any code change, this skill automatically runs type checks via tsc, fixes lint issues with Biome/ESLint, sorts imports, detects complex Effect-TS patterns, and asks NEURO for regression validation. It repeats until no type or lint errors remain.
howto.when_en: Triggers after any code change, bug fix, or new feature; also runs on refactors, API changes, and configuration modifications. Marked as a mandatory post-implementation step whenever source files are modified.

say_en.text: Run a type check and fix all TypeScript errors.
Check my recent changes and fix lint errors.
My code has Effect-TS type errors—please fix them.
say_en.note: Matches error family and applies built-in fix patterns.
